Docs.summary:
Extension methods to register the Responses API server on an , binding the Foundry credential and endpoint from a single configuration section (the pattern). This is the required entry point in hosted Foundry environments: because response storage and resilient-task storage bind the SAME and from one section, the two cannot diverge.
In a hosted Foundry environment, values the section does not provide fall back to the platform: Endpoint defaults to FOUNDRY_PROJECT_ENDPOINT, and an absent Credential section defaults to a limited by default to the production credentials (environment, workload identity and managed identity; AZURE_TOKEN_CREDENTIALS overrides the selection). The resolved credential and endpoint are shared by response storage and resilient-task storage, and the credential is never published to the service collection. Credential settings that are present (in configuration or set by the configureSettings callback) but do not resolve are an error; they are never replaced by the fallback.
